step_labels: CONFIRM FLOW AND CLOSE GARDEN VALVE

role_cards.name: Kai
facts: The battery holds 20. Daylight adds 8 in shifts 1 and 2 only; anything above 20 is lost.
Shifts 3 to 7 are dark: five shifts, 36 hours, running only on what is stored.
Every shift costs 1 for basics, plus heat (night only), the air maker and the garden light.
A demand below zero is a blackout: the battery resets to 0 and air, Alo and the crop each lose 2. Ending a shift at exactly 0 is an empty-battery warning, not a blackout.

role_cards.name: Amara
role_cards.quote: We can keep air we make now. We cannot keep overflow.
facts: The air tank holds 10. The crew of four breathes 1 per shift.
The air maker turns 1 energy into 1 air, up to 2 per shift, before breathing.
Make air while sunlight would overflow the battery.
If air reaches 0, the flight rules stop the mission.

role_cards.name: Rafi
role_cards.quote: First rule: the crew goes inside.
facts: A large solar flare was observed. In this training scenario a particle event may follow during shifts 5 and 6.
Shelter S = water wall + supply crates, at most 6. Dose per storm shift: S 0–1 gives 3, 2–3 gives 2, 4–5 gives 1, 6 gives 0.
The crew exposure limit is 3 game units for the night. These are training units, not sieverts.
One water transfer per shift: FILL +2, DRAIN −2 or HOLD. At shift 5 the alarm response replaces it. Crates come down before shift 7.

role_cards.name: Mei
role_cards.quote: Read my cold-and-thirst card with Rafi's warning.
facts: Garden light changes Alo and the crop each shift: OFF −1, DIM 0, FULL +1.
At night COOL costs Alo 1. COLD costs Alo 2 and the crop 1. COZY costs neither.
The water wall borrows garden water. At 4 or more after the transfer, Alo and the crop are thirsty: −1 each.
Alo at 0 cannot recover in this attempt.

hints: Store air while sunlight would overflow.
Prepare shielding before the alarm, then return the water.
Open the worked Bloom plan or Guided plan.
golden_hints: Golden needs Alo at 5 or more with no blackout, so every drop must reach the garden at exactly the right time.

GOLDEN.title: GOLDEN BLOOM
GOLDEN.summary: All three stars and Alo at 5 or more. The rare expert result.

BLOOM.title: BLOOM
BLOOM.summary: The crew is safe and Alo is alive at sunrise.

ALO_LOST.title: ALO LOST
ALO_LOST.summary: The crew completed the night safely, but Alo did not survive. Retry the last shift checkpoint to try again.

MISSION_STOPPED.title: MISSION STOPPED
MISSION_STOPPED.summary: Flight rules stopped operations. Read the cause, then retry from the last shift checkpoint.
